description: Given a list of integers a and a valid index j (0 <= j < length of a), return the list obtained from a by setting the element at index j to 60, leaving every other element unchanged.
notes: VERINA's postcondition (result[j]! = 60 and result[k]! = a[k]! for every other k < |a|) does not fix the length of the result. Reading result[k]! as an in-range access gives |result| >= |a|, which both specs state; like VERINA they do not require equal lengths.
